title: Yulia Possible NDE 3702
content: That night I suddenly felt ill. I had, without any reason, sharp and torturing pain in the lower abdomen, like menstrual cramps, but much stronger; I did not have this before. Somehow, I thought of pelvic peritonitis and called my friend, a healer, right away to get help. (I did not want to go to the hospital at all, especially because I was sure of a surgery.) My friend lived nearby and I was at his place in about ten minutes. The pain in my abdomen grew continuously and I was becoming very anxious. My friend only briefly looked at me and started to prepare for a healing ritual. After about five more minutes I was standing in the middle of his room, the lights were off with only a few candles glowing. All that my friend did was looking at the different part of my body, keeping silent, without any hand movements. In a couple of minutes, I felt that I was losing consciousness. I had cases of fainting before and knew how it felt and told the healer about that. He firmly ordered me to get myself together, keep standing and do not give up. I nodded and really tried to do what he told. Suddenly I saw my body from outside - it was standing vertically and from the front of it, along the centerline, I saw several rays of a bright light bursting from a few spots on the body. I though those were chakras (after I awakened, I asked my friend what he was doing, and he replied that he was healing me using a method based on 'flushing the chakras', possibly that is what I saw; before the experience I did not know what he would be doing). I looked at my body from aside, without any amazement or feeling sorry. Suddenly I was in a huge 'funnel'. It was a pipe, very large in diameter, going far, so much that it looked that its walls narrowed into a point (that's why I say 'funnel'). The funnel was colored and brightly lit. The walls of the funnel were colored along a helix, all colors were bright and clean; I only recognized red and yellow, about other colors I thought I had never seen them before. I had a feeling of a complete reality of the experience! I flew through the funnel along a spiral at a great speed, very loud noise in my ears, like a very strong wind. On the walls of the funnel, not sure how they were attached, there were some unusual objects; at that moment I knew what they were, but forgot later, I have a vague feeling that they were toys. While flying, I heard voices talking to me. They were a bit with an echo, with unusual timbre, I think now that they were muffled as by cotton. Then I clearly understood what they were telling me and knew that they belong to three apostles, but when I returned, I forgot what they were saying. Being in the 'funnel', I felt happy, free, joyfully amazed like a child. I had a feeling, that in my earthly life I saw everything through a very dusty glass. Then I felt that somebody caught me in an extremely rude way and threw me back. I was back in the room where the ritual was going on. I was on my back on the floor; the healer was leaning over me, pressing ice to my stomach in the navel area. I realized where I was and became hysterical - I wanted back. When calmed down (i.e. after about ten minutes), I realized that my pain was gone, my weakness was gone and I was well overall. The healer told me that I almost flew away from him 'to the other side', but he was able to catch me. During the next week, I had blood in my urine, gradually disappearing. I did not see any doctors.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Saw her body from outside while it was standing vertically; viewed it from the front and then from the side.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A huge, brightly lit, colored 'funnel' like a large-diameter pipe narrowing to a point in the distance; walls colored along a helix.
tunnel.movement_other_detail: Flew through along a spiral at great speed; very loud noise like a strong wind.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt 'somebody caught me in an extremely rude way and threw me back.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden severe lower abdominal pain with near-fainting during a healer's ritual (candles, lights off).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed bright light rays from spots along the body's centerline (interpreted as chakras after the fact).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with viewing body and light rays, then tunnel/funnel with voices, then abrupt forced return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Healer ritual context; saw bright rays from multiple spots along the body's centerline (interpreted as chakras). Tunnel walls had unusual objects she later vaguely felt were 'toys'. Voices identified as 'three apostles' but content forgotten. Afterward: pain and weakness gone; blood in urine for a week.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I had a feeling of a complete reality of the experience!”; “I flew through the funnel along a spiral at a great speed, very loud noise in my ears, like a very strong wind.”; “I felt that somebody caught me in an extremely rude way and threw me back.”; “I wanted back.”
